name: Bounty & Soul Food, Education and Volunteer Hub
addr: 1038 Old US Hwy 70, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: Very sweet, caring group of people. They have had events and times that there were other organizations there for assistance as well. It is helpful to have someone who can help ease navigating the many hurdles you face post Helene and to know that you're not alone
It was very clean and the people there were very friendly & helpful! I have a family of 9 5 adults and 4 grandkids and it was food enough for all of us for a couple of days.

Wow! Such nice accommodating people. Helped by getting a shopping cart for me and then carried my bags out to my car. This is a great help for me since I live on my SS and it's not much. Thank you so much!!
